name: Approval without vote
title: RECOMMENDATION FOR SECOND READING on the Council position at first reading with a view to the adoption of a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on European statistics on population and housing, amending Regulation (EC) No 862/2007 and repealing Regulations (EC) No 763/2008 and (EU) No 1260/2013
part_text:
The European Parliament has approved a new law on European statistics about population and housing. It replaces three older laws with one set of rules. The law covers how European countries collect and share data on how many people live where and what kind of homes they have. Parliament accepted the deal already agreed with the Council of the European Union, so the law can now come into force.

- **What changes:** Three old laws on population and housing statistics are replaced by one new law.
- **Who it affects:** National statistics offices in European Union countries and Eurostat, the European Union's statistics office.
- **What happens next:** The law is signed and published, then it applies.
